summary: Iteration 99 verified Bundle Cover Studio, Imprint Rollout, and Publish Preview Everywhere end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest passing (1 skipped variant). Frontend: catalog imprint filter, bundle detail branded cover, founder bundles manager (regenerate cover w/ toast), Book Manufacturing edit-imprint-select w/ both imprints, Media Studio media-catalog-destination, Product Family family-destinations w/ family-dest-* chips — all verified.

issues: Book cover art still bakes 'QRU PRESS™' badge on top for books whose imprint metadata is 'E.Q. Rothwell™' (e.g., 'The Understanding Tree', 'Ordinary Tuesdays') — the underlying cover PNG is a pre-rendered asset and is not re-generated when imprint metadata changes. Documented/expected per E1's note; user-visible mismatch between top badge (QRU PRESS™) and bottom byline (E.Q. Rothwell).

Repeat of prior iteration: React hydration warning — <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Console errors on every render (BookManufacturing L240, ProductFamily L83, MediaStudio L88). Not blocking; noise only.

action_items: Optional: regenerate book cover art whenever the book.imprint is changed via /api/book-mfg/books/{id}/publication-details so the baked badge matches the imprint metadata (currently only bundle covers auto-regenerate).
Optional: strip decorated <span> children out of <option> renderers in BookManufacturing/ProductFamily/MediaStudio to remove hydration warnings.
Founder /bundles manager: consider adding a fixed test-id like 'bundle-card-{id}' on each row to make selection deterministic (current 'bundle-cover-{id}' + 'cover-{id}' are sufficient).
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/bundles/{id}/cover returns {ok:true} without echoing back the updated cover_url — clients must re-GET to obtain the new URL. Minor DX improvement to include the fresh cover_url in the response.
POST /api/bundles/{id}/publish also returns only {ok:true}; considered returning the mutated bundle for parity with POST /api/bundles which returns {ok, bundle}.
GET /api/public/books now returns {books,count,imprints}; frontend catalog correctly derives chips from this list — good.
Bundle cover generator is deterministic + $0 (no LLM call) as advertised — good.
Auth guard on POST /api/bundles/{id}/cover returns 401/403 for anonymous — good.
seed_data_creation: Tests are self-cleaning: TEST_ bundle created + regenerated + published then deleted. Publication-details imprint change reverted at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe LIVE — only session creation tested. Bundle create endpoint accepts 'price' (dollars) NOT 'price_cents'. Bundle create returns {ok:true, bundle:{...}}; publish/cover return only {ok:true} — must GET /api/bundles/{id} to inspect updated cover_url. Public books endpoint requires no query for full 8 books; filter via ?imprint=E.Q.%20Rothwell%E2%84%A2 returns 3; ?imprint=QRU%20Press%E2%84%A2 returns 5. Founder Bundles Manager card selectors: img[data-testid='bundle-cover-{id}'], button[data-testid='cover-{id}']. Product Family flow: family-source-select -> click intent-{key} -> 'Confirm the Family' panel auto-appears with family-destinations + family-dest-{type} chips (no separate confirm button). Media Studio: click any media-item-* -> right pane shows Publish section including media-catalog-destination block.
